verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a web search feature that finds relevant websites from a single query, and a separate fetch feature that converts a URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. Nothing shows search results returning full page content in a single call; chaining search and fetch is a user-side composition, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
